decision: Do exact action/time alignment and portable current-root facts contain held-out factual signal for executed movement, future observed-shield contraction, and physical HIT at fixed game-frame horizons?

gate.proceed_rule: dynamics gate passes and at least one sufficient HIT horizon and one sufficient shield-collapse horizon pass the frozen proper-score gate
gate.risk_proper_score: upper endpoint of 2000-draw complete-episode bootstrap 95 percent interval for candidate minus train-prevalence validation Brier is below zero

hypotheses.H1_action_time_alignment: A train-only executed-action delta-x/delta-y table will reduce held-out joint MSE to at most one quarter of the global-mean MSE, and publication is either at least 99.9 percent identical to the first witnessed executed action or executed-action conditioning beats published-action conditioning by at least 20 percent over at least 100 mismatches.
hypotheses.H2_current_root_shield_signal: At least one sufficiently supported fixed horizon has a complete-episode bootstrap upper bound below zero for current-root action-conditioned shield-collapse Brier relative to the frozen train-prevalence constant.
hypotheses.H3_current_root_hit_signal: At least one sufficiently supported fixed horizon has a complete-episode bootstrap upper bound below zero for current-root action-conditioned physical-HIT Brier relative to the frozen train-prevalence constant. This is predictive evidence only, not policy or gameplay improvement.
hypotheses.H4_history_boundary: This pilot never admits history. A negative risk probe first requires a separately preregistered attribution distinguishing transparent current-root model insufficiency, event scarcity, and temporal ambiguity. A positive probe leaves history unsupported.

non_goals: no new collection, Wine execution, corpus mutation, policy export, canary, or gameplay claim
no counterfactual successor, replay-generated transition, reward shaping, value target, IQL, OPE, or actor fitting
no stage, boss, spell, ECL, RNG, run identity, future fact, source address, or counterexample-specific feature
no history, MLP, recurrent encoder, object-set encoder, ensemble, model sweep, horizon sweep, threshold tuning, or post-hoc calibration
physical HIT is the only cost; shield collapse and movement are factual auxiliary diagnostics and never rewards

probes.dynamics_target: first contiguous raw transition executed delta-x/delta-y
probes.hit_target: any exact physical life_lost within the contiguous horizon
probes.shield_collapse_target: within horizon: explicit observed-shield control dead end or strict contraction to a positive shield-action count below the start count; zero passive/HIT counts alone are excluded
probes.validation_use: load and evaluate validation exactly once after serializing the train-only fit; never select a feature, horizon, threshold, or model

prototype_debt: the transparent linear-probability probe clips predictions to [0,1]; a passing signal may later justify a bounded calibrated classifier under a new preregistration
the pilot performs one fully validated decision-epoch pass and one fully validated raw-transition pass per episode instead of materializing a derived cache
four validation episodes bound the episode-bootstrap resolution; this pilot is a representation diagnostic, not a promotion experiment
